Debunking the Dumbest Claims From Online Fitness Influencers

My patience for other people's dogs is zero. If I'm inconvenienced or disrupted by someone's dog for even one second, it's unacceptable. Your dog should just not ever be my problem. But children are human beings. They are the next generation. We need them to exist and be participants in society or else human society goes extinct. Therefore the baseline patience we have for kids, even when they're slightly disruptive, should be INFINITELY higher than our baseline patience for dogs. And yet a lot

No it's not. Your dog smells, eats his own shit, and barks. Your dog has no fundamental right to participate in society at all. Children do.


Sammy Boop! (@samdattola1)

My dog is cleaner and more well behaved than lots of children.

fuck off!



— https://nitter.net/samdattola1/status/2059990037932962135#m

People act like there are children just running wild everywhere they go. It's totally delusional. We've constructed this whole narrative where every public space is overridden by tantruming children and it's just not even remotely true at all. You are far, far more likely to be disrupted in your day to day life by rude adults than misbehaving children.


Xenomayo (@xenomayo)

Kids are less behaved than they used to be, and public shaming needs to return because as of right now dogs are significa
Children are members of society and should be allowed to participate in it. Dogs are not members of society at all. They are dogs. Keep your dog at home or take him to a dog park.

It's insane that we're constantly having this conversation about whether kids should be allowed in restaurants etc, meanwhile people bring their dogs everywhere. We now live in a society where dogs are more welcome in public than human children. It's psychotic.

Agreed. I take all my kids to nice restaurants all the time. They've never been disruptive. Tables of adults are far more likely to cause a disruption than my kids. By the age of 4 kids should be perfectly capable of sitting quietly at any restaurant and having a meal without being an annoyance to any of the other diners.


Mike M (@kineticquant)

Yup it's the clientele and the pay threshold. I take my very young kids to upscale restaurants all the time. They're well-mannered and will happily ea

Also, by the way, I've rarely seen unruly kids at places like Applebees either. I've only ever seen them at those kinds of places, but rarely even there. All these people claiming to encounter unruly hellions everywhere they go -- where exactly are you spending your time?
You can't go to restaurants where the hostess hands out crayons and then act horrified when children show up. The children aren't invading your space. You're invading theirs.

If you don't want to be around kids at a restaurant then fork over the money to go to a nice upscale place. I don't think I've ever in my life seen an "unruly child" at a restaurant where the average entree costs more than like 30 or 40 dollars. Unruly kids are only ever a problem at spots like Applebees. But if you want to eat that kind of slop, you're going to have to be around children. People want to go to a place and pay 14 bucks for an entree with sides and also not be around kids. Sorry.

I am begging conservatives to let go of this “cling onto literally any famous people who give us the time of day” mentality. That strategy has officially led us to rock bottom, in the form of a concert that features —and this somehow is not a joke—  Milli Vanilli and Vanilla Ice.

Martina McBride, Young MC, C+C Music Factory, Vanilla Ice, Milli Vanilli, The Commodo

Please be more specific. These are very clearly “black teen takeovers” because stable households are essentially extinct in the urban black community and none of these kids have dads at home.


Matt Van Swol (@mattvanswol)

🚨OH. MY. GOSH!!!

An absolutely MASSIVE "teen takeover" at a park in Detroit erupted MASS BRAWLS, SMASHING WINDOWS, and ended with a 16-year-old being shot.

Residents say they are TERRIFIED about the summer months and don't know what to do.

WE DON'T HAVE TO LIVE LIKE THIS!!
